chunks.text: Preface Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0) has been launched with an objective to provide pucca houses to 1 crore people of urban India. The Scheme emphasizes on empowerment of urban poor and middle-class families by giving them secured pucca houses to focus on the betterment of their lives. PMAY-U 2.0 will provide financial assistance to 1 crore families to construct, purchase or rent a house in urban areas over a period of 5 years. Government Assistance of ₹2.30 lakh crore will be provided under the Scheme. Families belonging to EWS/LIG/MIG segments, having no pucca house anywhere in the country, are eligible to purchase or construct a house under PMAY-U 2.0. The Scheme will be implemented through different verticals, giving eligible beneficiaries the option avail benefits under any one of the four verticals as per their choice and eligibility. A unified web portal has been developed to effectively execute the Scheme. It also ensures transparency, helps in monitoring and efficient management of the Scheme and more importantly, to enable beneficiaries to directly apply under PMAY-U 2.0. The portal simplifies the process for application, allows beneficiaries to know the status of application, modalities of data exchange among stakeholders, ensures faster due- diligence, approval and release of subsidy. The web portal is accessible to all stakeholders and will help in monitoring and evaluating of PMAY-U 2.0 scheme. The user manual will help the beneficiaries and all stakeholders about the web portal and will guide them on how to use it effectively. It will take the users through the portal's features, sections, tools to ensure smooth implementation.

Background PMAY-U, launched in June 2015, is one of the major flagship programmes of Government of India to provide all-weather pucca houses to all eligible beneficiaries in the urban areas. Based on the learnings gathered during the implementation of the PMAY-U Scheme and, also to meet the housing requirements arising out of the increase in the number of eligible families, the Union Cabinet on 10th June 2024 resolved to provide assistance to 3 crore additional rural and urban households for the construction of houses. Subsequently, on 9th August 2024, the Union Cabinet, chaired by the Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, approved Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 for the next 5 years. In pursuance of the Hon’ble Prime Minister’s vision, PMAY-U 2.0 will address the housing needs of 1 crore families, ensuring that every citizen leads a better quality of life. The Scheme will be implemented through the following four verticals: • Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC) • Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP) • Affordable Rental Housing (ARH) • Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) About Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) PMAY-U 2.0 will achieve the vision of ‘Housing for All’ by fulfilling the housing dreams of EWS/LIG/MIG segments. The Scheme will also ensure equity across different segments of population by addressing the requirement of slum dwellers, SC/STs, minorities, widows, Persons with Disabilities and other underprivileged sections of the society. Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) vertical is implemented as a Central Sector Scheme to expand institutional credit flow to the affordable housing sector though implementing agencies such as CNAs viz; NHB/SBI/HUDCO and PLIs. Subsidy will be provided on home loans sanctioned and disbursed on 01.09.2024 or after to eligible beneficiaries of EWS/LIG and MIG for purchase/ re- purchase/construction of houses. For scheme implementation, Primary Lending Institutions such as Scheduled Commercial Banks, Housing Finance Companies, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), State Cooperative Banks, Urban Cooperative Banks [Small Financial Banks, Non- Banking Financial Company- Micro Finance Institutions’ (NBFC- MFIs)] or any other financial institutions as may be identified by the RBI are eligible to claim subsidy on eligible home loans only after signing of MoU with

Primary Lending Institutions such as Scheduled Commercial Banks, Housing Finance Companies, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), State Cooperative Banks, Urban Cooperative Banks [Small Financial Banks, Non- Banking Financial Company- Micro Finance Institutions’ (NBFC- MFIs)] or any other financial institutions as may be identified by the RBI are eligible to claim subsidy on eligible home loans only after signing of MoU with one of the CNAs for implementation of the Scheme. The system will ensure that the loan is taken from

a financial institution that is a Primary Lending Institution (PLI) registered under PMAY-U 2.0 for ISS. Roles and Responsibility of PLI: • PLI is responsible for claiming the subsidy of their existing borrower. • PLI are also required to take action on applications of interested citizens who have shown interest for taking loan. • PLI are required to enter the detail information of beneficiary/borrower and family details such as co-borrower details and submit applications for review and approval by MoHUA/CNAs. • PLI is responsible for crediting the subsidy into home loan account of the beneficiary upon release of funds from MoHUA through CNAs into the PLI account.

Coverage All Statutory Towns as per Census 2011 and towns notified subsequently and areas falling within the boundary of Notified Planning Areas, Notified Planning/Development area under the jurisdiction of Industrial Development Authority/Special Area Development Authority/Urban Development Authority or any such Authority under State legislation which is entrusted with the functions of urban planning and regulations shall be included for the coverage under the Scheme for all verticals. The Cities/Towns and areas falling under Notified Planning Areas, Notified Planning/Development area under the jurisdiction of Industrial Development Authority/Special Area Development Authority/Urban Development Authority or any such Authority, where PMAY-U is being implemented will continue to be covered under PMAY-U 2.0. Cities/towns which were not part of PMAY-U may also be included in PMAY-U 2.0 with due approval of MoHUA. List of cities can also be accessed at PMAY-U 2.0 website under publication. Preference group List of Other Government schemes under which applicants could have availed benefits: National Health Mission (NHM), Ayushman Bharat, Swachh Bharat Mission - Urban (SBM-U) 2.0, Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM), PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY), Unnat Jyoti by Affordable LEDs for All (Ujala), Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT). PMAY-U 2.0 also focusses on special groups such as Safai Karmi, Street Vendors identified under Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's Atma Nirbhar Nidhi (PMSVANidhi) Scheme and different artisans under Pradhan Mantri- Vishwakarma Scheme, Anganwadi Workers, Building and other Construction Workers (BoCW), slum dwellers/chawls and other groups identified during operation of the scheme.

Scheme features1 Eligibility 1. The beneficiary can find out their eligibility based on the following eligibility parameters under ISS at unified web portal: a. Undertaking on not owning a house anywhere in India except for the one being acquired/constructed b. Declaration on not availing benefit under any housing schemes in last 20 years c. Household income is not exceeding ₹9 lakh per annum d. Home loan is not more than ₹25 lakh e. House value is not more than ₹35 lakh f. Carpet area of the house is not more than 120sqm 2. A beneficiary family will comprise of husband, wife, unmarried sons and/or unmarried daughters. User must fill the details of all family members with Aadhar Details, Date of Birth, Relationship with Beneficiary and Occupation. 3. In case of a married male, details of wife should be included; and in case of unmarried children, their details should be included. 4. In case if the borrower is unmarried and earning, then he/she can take loan with parents/siblings. 5. EWS households are defined as households with an annual income up to ₹3 lakh. LIG households are households with an annual income from ₹3 lakh up to ₹6 lakh. MIG households are households with an annual income from ₹6 lakh up to ₹9 lakh. 6. As per the scheme guidelines, under ISS vertical, a maximum interest subsidy of ₹1.80 lakh is provided to eligible beneficiaries having annual family income up to ₹9 lakh. Home loan value up to ₹25 lakh for property value up to ₹35 lakh with carpet area of houses up to 120 sqm. are eligible for a subsidy at 4.0% on first ₹8 lakh for a tenure up to 12 years. 7. The subsidy will be provided to those beneficiaries who have submitted the approved layout plan to the PLIs as per guidelines of States/UTs. However, the layout plan may not be insisted by PLIs where States/UTs have provided the exemption for construction of houses having provision of deemed 1 These are to be referred with main guidelines of PMAY-U 2.0 only.

beneficiaries who have submitted the approved layout plan to the PLIs as per guidelines of States/UTs. However, the layout plan may not be insisted by PLIs where States/UTs have provided the exemption for construction of houses having provision of deemed 1 These are to be referred with main guidelines of PMAY-U 2.0 only.

approval or pre-approved building plan. Timeline 8. Subsidy will be provided on home loans sanctioned and disbursed on 01.09.2024 or after to eligible beneficiaries of EWS/LIG and MIG for purchase/ re-purchase/construction of houses. 9. For availing the benefit under ISS vertical, the PLI shall claim the subsidy amount through a proper channel within thirty (30) days from the date of disbursement of home loan to the beneficiary; otherwise, it shall be responsibility of the PLI. 10. Subsidy will be released in 5 yearly instalments in home loan accounts provided loan is standard and live at the time of release of subsidy and more than 50% principal is outstanding. 11. PLI are required to update the credit /non-credit of subsidy in beneficiary account on UWP within 7 days from the date of funds released by CNAs to the PLI Ac. 12. Physical progress of the construction of a house is required to be updated on the annual basis, for claiming of each instalment against a loan account over 5 years. It is to be ensured by PLI that before releasing of 4th instalment (subsidy) to the beneficiary the geo-tagging of house at completed level is to be captured in MIS/UWB in 4th year. Points to note 13. A citizen who wants to take loan and avail interest subsidy is required to submit the application through Unified Web Portal of PMAY-U 2.0, Common Service Centre (CSC) or by visiting the concerned Urban Local Bodies/Municipalities/Primary Lending Institution (PLI). 14. PLIs will not take any processing charge from the beneficiary for housing loans up to the eligible loan amount (upto 8 lakh) under the Scheme. 15. A 'Pucca' house is defined as an all-weather dwelling unit with roof and

walls made up of sturdy, modern, and durable materials like burnt bricks, stones packed with cement or lime, cement concrete, timber, Galvanized Iron (GI) sheets, asbestos sheets, machine-made tiles etc. 16. Present address is the current location where the applicant is residing at the time of registration. 17. Permanent address is the official and long-term residence of the applicant as per the legal or official documents. 18. Construction site address is the location where the housing construction or the proposed site of construction under PMAY-U 2.0. 19. The subsidy under the scheme will be provided only once for a property. If it is sold to someone else, the purchaser can’t take benefit of ISS on this property. PLIs are to ensure that subsidy benefit is not taken by the previous owner by checking on the unified web portal, before initiating the claim of the current occupant. 20. The houses under PMAY-U 2.0 will be used only for residential purpose and shall not use for any other activities and the same will be self-certified by the beneficiaries. Otherwise, the Subsidy will be discontinued, and recovery of already leased amount shall be recovered. 21. Preference under the scheme will also be given to widows, Persons with Disabilities, transgenders, persons belonging to Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes, and Minorities. 22. A loan given for land purchase and construction shall be limited to ₹25 lakh only and the cost of land plus construction cost shall not exceed ₹35 lakh and the size of the house constructed shall not exceed 120 sqm. 23. Geo-tagging through Bhuvan/Bharat HFA/PMAY mobile application, of houses along with their geo-spatial location is required to be done by the respective PLI/Beneficiary as per the payment plan. Geo-tagging of houses to be done after release of 1st instalment, in case of purchase of completed house. In case of construction/under construction house, Geo-tagging is to be done before release of each instalment.
release of 1st instalment, in case of purchase of completed house. In case of construction/under construction house, Geo-tagging is to be done before release of each instalment.

Exclusions/Ineligibility Criteria under ISS 24. The subsidy under the scheme will be provided only once per property. If it is sold to someone else, the purchaser can’t take benefits of ISS on this property. 25. If two or more family members take combined or separate loan on same property, they will be treated as same family for calculation of family income and benefit. 26. In case a borrower has taken a housing loan from one PLI and later switches to another PLI for balance transfer such beneficiary will not be eligible to claim the benefit of interest subsidy again. If a person has not claimed interest subsidy from first PLI, he/she shall not be eligible after balance transfer. 27. Only loan up to 25 lakhs with the house value up to 35 lakhs will be eligible for subsidy under this vertical. 28. In case of any false declaration on income level by a beneficiary who has already availed the scheme benefits, he/she will be liable for legal proceedings under applicable laws.

How to Log in PLI dashboard? The PMAY 2.0 MIS website can be accessed on- PMAY-HFA(Urban). On the website homepage, ULB can find the Login link by clicking on State/ULB/PLI login. Click on Officer Login The system would take open a new tab. Input the log in credentials as provided and captcha to login.

Change Password User can change the default password by clicking on “Change Password” tab on the menu bar. (i) Check the Username (ii) Enter the old Password (iii) Enter the new password and Confirm the New Password. (iv) Click on Save to change password successfully. (v) In case of errors, click on Reset.

Create Branch User Bank PLI have the provision to create Sub-PLIs to enable the city level information can be entered by branch staff. The information filled by the Sub-user shall reflect in PLI login, which can be submitted by PLI or returned by PLI to Sub-PLI for editing (i) Click on Admin from Taskbar. (ii) Click on Admin for PLI and then click on Create Branch User for PLI

(iii) The system will display radio-button where User can select State/District/City to map the jurisdiction of the Branch ID Note: Applications forms filled by the applicants will be visible in the Branch IDs as per the jurisdiction selected during the branch creation and the Property Address summited by the applicant.

Branch List for Activate and Deactivate User can check the list of created Branch User IDs and manage them from the Head Office Login. (i) Click on Branch List for Activate and Deactivate. (ii) User can view the Login IDs, Branch Name, Email ID & Mobile number associated with the Branch as well as the Status of The ID. (iii) To Deactivate/Activate a Branch ID, click on the button under Action column.

Applications for Approval The applications forwarded by the Branch User will be visible to the Head office under Action Tab in the menu bar. (i) Click on Action. (ii) Click on Application Status- Applications received from branch. (iii) Once clicked, applications that are pending for approval by head office will be visible under this tab. (iv) Head office can Verify and forward the application to CNA or send to branch for clarification.

Manual for Branch User To view the beneficiary survey application forms that are filled under the ISS component- (i) Click on “Action”. (ii) System will display- a) Application Status and b) Submit Application for subsidy: Loan already taken Verify Application for Home Loan- This is applicable in cases where the Citizen has already applied for Loan from the concerned PLI, and the application is to be verified by the Branch Office.

The system would display all the beneficiary application form that are pending to be verified at branch level. The User can filter the applications based on Date of Entry. The user can also Search from the list of applications based on- • Application Number • Mobile Number • Loan Account Number • Name • Father’s Name • Aadhar Number The list of beneficiary application will be displayed in a format showing the Application Number, Name of Applicant, Fathers Name, Mobile
number, Loan Account Number, Date of Entry and Action. (i) From the displayed list, User can choose any of the application form they wish to process.

(ii) Click on Process under the action column to open the form. The system would display the form as filled by the beneficiary. Check the home loan details as filled by beneficiaries. This includes checking the Loan Account no, Loan Amount, property Value, Loan Sanction date and Loan Disbursement Date. Note: Loan Disbursement Date should be on or after 01. September.2024 and after the loan sanction date.

Process Application for Home Loan In cases where the applicant has not taken Loan before applying, the User would need to Process the Application. The system would display all the beneficiary application form that are pending to be verified at branch level. The User can filter the applications based on Date of Entry. The user can also Search from the list of applications based on- • Application Number • Mobile Number • Loan Account Number • Name • Father’s Name • Aadhar Number The list of beneficiary application will be displayed in a format showing the Application Number, Name of Applicant, Fathers Name, Mobile
number, Loan Account Number, Date of Entry and Action. (i) From the displayed list, User can choose any of the application form they wish to process.

(ii) Click on Process under the action column to open the form. The system would display the form as filled by the beneficiary. Here the beneficiary has not taken the Home Loan. User must enter the Loan Account No, Loan Amount, Property Value, Loan Sanction Date and Loan Disbursement Date must be filled. Note: Disbursement Date should be after the Loan Sanction Date

Verified Applications for Annexure 7 Once the Applications are Processed by the Branch User, the form would be visible at Verified Applications for submitting Annexure 7, and at Applications for Bio-metric Authentication and Geo- tagging. The User can submit Annexure 7 and Bio-metric Authentication and Geo-tagging in parallel stage. The status of the two would be visible on the List as either Completed or Pending. Process Annexure 7 The form has various sections

• Borrower Details: This section includes the basic details of the borrower such as- ✓ Name of Borrower (must be the same as in the Housing Loan Account number) ✓ Name as per Aadhaar ✓ Aadhar Number or Virtual Aadhar ID ✓ PAN card Number ✓ Mobile No. etc. Address details of Borrower- The Present and Permanent Address of borrower would be auto filled by the system as per the beneficiary application form as filled by the Applicant.

*Occupation- If Salaried (Government Employee, Private Sector Employee, Public Sector Employee) If Self-Employed (Freelancer, Contractor) If Business– (Small Business, Medium Business, Large Business) If Professional– (Doctor, Lawyer, Engineer, Finance professional, Architect/Planner, Teacher/Professor, Artist, Management Consultant, Other Professionals) If Homemaker- Homemaker If Non-Salaried [Farmer, Transport Driver, Street Vendors, Fisherman, Daily Wage Worker, Artisan, Ex-service man] **Distinct Sector- Sales & Marketing-/ Financial & Insurance Services/ Fashion & clothing/ Media & Entertainment / Infra and allied construction industry/ FMCG /Transport/ Health & wellbeing/Other Industry Once the details are filled, User can click on Save & Next to proceed. • Co-Borrower Details: User must enter the details of Co-borrower (wherever applicable). In case there is no co-borrower, User can skip this section by clicking on the next tab. Once the details are filled, User can click on Save & Next to proceed.

Family Member details and Property Details: Add the detailed information of family members of borrower. Property type: Carpet area of house (in sqm) Property Details- User must fill he property address, Loan purpose, Land ownership, property ownership, House value and Date of Valuation.

Lending Model: (i) Sole Lender A single lender such as a bank or financial institution is solely responsible for providing the loan (ii) Primary origination This refers to the process where one entity, usually a financial institution or lender originates and processes the loan, including marketing, underwriting, and approval (iii) Co-Lending

two or more lenders, often a bank and a non-bank financial company collaborate to provide a loan to a borrower Type of Interest- Specify the interest rate structure for the loan- Fixed or Floating Note: Date of Repayment should be after the Date of Loan Sanction. Mortgage Guarantee: Indicates the type of guarantee for the mortgage (CRGFTLIH /Others). Guarantee Amount: The monetary value of the guarantee provided for the loan (in ₹).

Is the Loan Covered Under AHF/PSL: Indicates whether the loan is covered under AHF (Affordable Housing Fund) or PSL (Priority Sector Lending), with options for Yes or No. Property Insurance: Indicates if the property is insured (Yes/No). Once the details are filled, User can click on Save & Next to proceed to the next section.

Subsidy Claim Information In case where the Loan account is Active- The User would need to select Active radio button. In cases where Loan Account is Closed- Select Closed radio button and choose the reason from the dropdown.

Loan Amount Details: Loan Amount Disbursed Date: Enter the exact date when the loan amount was disbursed in the format (dd/mm/yyyy). Loan Outstanding Check: Indicate whether the loan outstanding amount exceeds 50% of the total disbursed amount by selecting 'Yes' or 'No'. Principal Outstanding: Specify the remaining principal amount (in ₹) that is yet to be repaid. Interest Outstanding: Enter the outstanding interest amount (in ₹) pending repayment.

Applications for Bio-metric Authentication and Geo- tagging Once the Applications are Processed by the Branch User, the application form would be visible at Verified Applications for submitting Annexure 7, and at Applications for Bio-metric Authentication and Geo-tagging. The User can submit Annexure 7 and Bio-metric Authentication and Geo-tagging in parallel stage. The status of the two would be visible on the List as either Completed or Pending. Note: Bio-metric Autentication and Geo-tagging images can only be done thorugh the PMAY-U Mobile App Sub PLI Login Authenticate with User name and Password Check the details and geotagging status of applicants Select the applicant for Geotagging Applicant will give the consent for face authentication Face authentication will confirm with UIDAI server Applicant will geotagged after successfully face authentication

Geo-tagging Mobile Application- Creation of Geo-Tagger Step 1: User must first login from the Branch User ID (Sub PLI) . Step 2: On the menu bar, click on “Create Geo Tagger” . The system will display existing geo-taggers, or you can create new Geo-tagger by clicking on green button- “Click here to add new Geo Tagger” Step 3: Enter the details of Geo-Tagger Agent such as Name as per Aadhar, Aadhar No, Password, Mobile number and Email. Confirm Password and click on Save.

PMAY-U 2.0 Mobile Application a) Once the Mobile Application is Installed on the device. b) Open the PMAY (U) App. c) User can see various features that are available on the PMAY (U) Application such as- About PMAY-U 2.0, FAQs, News & Media, Survey Form etc. The Geo-Tagging feature in the PMAY (Urban) mobile application is designed to enable users to: 1. Capture and upload two high-resolution photographs of the construction site. 2. Capture and upload one image of the beneficiary. Scroll down to find the ISS Tab on the Mobile Application Home Page.
Step1: Branch PLI must create Geo-Tagger using the Name and Aadhar Number of the field surveyor. Step 2: Log-in to Geo-Tagger ID, using the User ID created by the Branch for Geo-tagging.

NOTE: PLEASE NOTE THAT FOR ISS GEO-TAGGING LOGIN ON MOBILE APP BRANCH PLI MUST CRAETE GEO-TAGGER AND USE THAT CREDENTIALS. Step 3: User must complete Aadhar face authentication before proceeding with the geo-tagging process to verify their identity. NOTE: Please verify the masked Aadhar number is the same as user Aadhar number.

Step 4: Once authenticated, select among pre-verifier or construction stage geo- tagging. • Pre-Verifier ID: Used for verification of the property image submitted with the application. • Construction Stage: Applicable for beneficiaries whose first instalment has been released, to record the current stage of construction.

Step 5: After logging in and selecting the geo-tagging stage, the user can choose an application from the applicant list to proceed with geo-tagging. Step 5: Aadhaar authentication of Applicant by face authentication. Step 6: Click images for Geo-tagging.

Applicant Self Geo-Tagging for ISS Vertical 1. Introduction Geo-tagging of applicants under the ISS vertical of PMAY-U enables faster, more accurate verification by allowing applicants to authenticate and submit location- based data themselves. 2. Prerequisites Before starting the geo-tagging process, ensure the following: • Smartphone with internet connectivity. • GPS/location services enabled on the device. • Camera permissions granted. • Applicant’s Aadhaar number. 3. Step-by-Step Geo-Tagging Process Step 1: Install PMAY Mobile application

Step 2: Allow Necessary Permissions When prompted, allow: • Location Access • Camera Access Step 3: Access the Geo-Tagging Section 1. Open the app. 2. Navigate to the ISS tab. 3. Select Verifying Applicant. 4. Enter the applicant’s Aadhaar Number. 5. Click Proceed. Step 4: Complete Face Authentication • Position the applicant in a well-lit area. • Use a high-resolution camera for clarity. • Follow on-screen instructions.

Step 5: Blink Verification • Wait for a green circle to appear. • Ask the applicant to blink once to complete liveness detection. Step 6: Access Geo-Tagging Page After Aadhaar authentication is successful, the system automatically opens the Geo-Tagging Page. Step 7: Capture Photos 1. Click the grey box to open the camera.

2. Take clear images of: o The property o The applicant standing in front of the property 3. Ensure good lighting and proper framing. Step 8: Submit Photos • Click the Submit button to upload the geo-tagged images. Step 9: Submission Confirmation • A confirmation message will appear: "Image submitted successfully".

Step 10: Close the Application • Click Close to complete the process. 4. Common Issues & Troubleshooting Issue 1: Location Not Detected • Ensure GPS is enabled. Issue 2: Face Authentication Failed • Clean the camera lens. • Improve lighting. • Re-align the face within the frame. Issue 3: Photo Upload Error • Check internet connectivity. • Try retaking the photograph. • Retry submission.

Subsidy Release Flow USER- AT CNA LEVEL Applications that have been verified and geo-tagged will then be sent to the CNA which the CNA would approve or reject. The approved applications would then be visible for the Demand Request. CNA can click on the application count to see the details of the application for which demand request is being generated.
Once the data is verified, CNA can Generate Request for the displayed PLIs The data would then reflect on “Release subsidy to PLI”

CNA can click on the No. of PLI, to see the detailed PLI list and subsidy amount CNA will then need to click on “Release to PLI” for each PLI. This would then reflect on Head Office PLI login. PLI will download the payment file first

NOTE: Payment file once downloaded will then be removed from here, PLI can upload this excel payment file to upload directly to PFMS. The applications then will be visible to release to beneficiary. PLI can now release subsidy to beneficiary for which payment file has been generated. PLI can see the release details, click on the applications to open the list of beneficiaries.

Upon clicking “Proceed to Release” against each beneficiary, the system will display the details. PLI needs to fill the following details- 1. Fund released in PFMS date 2. Date of credit in Beneficiary account. 3. PFMS transaction ID 4. Subsidy amount credited
Click on Proceed PLI may also reject applications at this point. If the beneficiary details are not released in PFMS, the PLI must enter the rejection reason for the user and reject on the portal.
Steps for subsequent claims 2nd installment can be claimed if : i - Loan is active, ii - Reverse MIS is updated, iii - Geotagging is above foundation
